description: 海底廢棄物種類及數量調查 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 海洋委員會海洋保育署. 透過研究船於近海測站進行底拖探測作業，針對海底廢棄物進行種類分析，進一步計算總重與總數量，並附上研究船進行底拖探測作業時的詳細資訊。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 海洋委員會海洋保育署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2025-07-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
